author: zero9178
body:
So as you all know Nexus came out with avicore and it is amazing, but there is one thing that kinda annoys me. There is no kit in Nexus where you have infinite amount of arrows. That makes the bow more like a assist weapon and not a main, even at kits like archer and sniper. My suggestion is to add a kit with infinite amount of arrows or edit sniper.
For Example:
-remove the wooden sword
-maybe change thew armor to some leather some chain or completly leather
-Add infinity to the bow or add that if you make a kill you get 3-5 arrows
